## Open access.

1. *Quantitative finance with R.* 2026. Series of open-access tutorials:
   - Credit risk. [https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_arf/](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_arf/) *Practical framework for credit risk measurement and modeling in R, from default prediction to portfolio credit risk.*
   - Forecasting. [https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_emf/](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_emf/) *End-to-end forecasting toolkit in R for economic and financial time series, combining classical and machine-learning approaches.*
   - Options and VaR. [https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_if/](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_if/) *Integrated introduction to derivatives and market risk in R, linking option valuation with Value-at-Risk analysis.*
   - Financial modeling. [https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_pmf/](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/tutorial_pmf/) *Applied financial modeling in R across valuation, asset allocation, and data-driven decision-making.*
   - Supervision guide. [https://mlozanoqf.github.io/supervision/](https://mlozanoqf.github.io/supervision/) *Structured guide for developing high-quality academic projects, from research design to writing, presentation, and project management.*

## Open source software.

1. *Credit risk in public firms.* 2023. First stage collaborators: Hernán González Aguilera, and Ramiro Castellanos Barrón. Available at [https://github.com/mlozanoqf/RunwayFinance](https://github.com/mlozanoqf/RunwayFinance)
1. *European options strategy analyzer.* 2026. Author: Dr. Martín Lozano. Interactive app to design and evaluate European options strategies, combining payoff visualization with scenario-based profit and risk analysis. Available at [https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/opstr/](https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/opstr/)
1. *Mini Crypto Miner: Eco-Friendly Proof-of-Work Challenge.* 2026. Author: Dr. Martín Lozano. Educational simulation of proof-of-work mining where users test nonces against a hash target in a local, no-crypto environment to understand mining logic and resource constraints. Available at [https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/pass/](https://mlozanoqf.shinyapps.io/pass/)
